---
title: "Adaptive market planning"
---

## Learning objectives

1. Compare adaptive marketing planning to selling assets in chapter 2

## Assets are always being sold in adaptive market planning

-   Assets like stocks are sold only once across time
    - Selling is binary (hold/sell)
    - Time periods are _connected_
-   Assets like baked goods are sold over time
    - Selling is continuous (based on demand)
    - Time periods are often _not connected_
